scriptOverride.reason: Overrides DrawCard.canPlay to forbid playing this card unless the controller is less honorable than their opponent - the same play-eligibility gap already flagged on cloud-the-mind/height-of-fashion, so only the canPlay restriction is scripted; the target/gameAction above are expressed generically. Also omits ringteki's anotherUniqueInPlay(context.player) cardCondition check (a unique-card duplicate-control edge case the state model doesn't track yet) - harmless for the current card pool since no Core Set target is unique-duplicated this way.
